inv.desc_en:
REF: 7047307

InmoOlaya offers you Commercial premises for sale in Barcelona in Sant Martí, one of the best areas of the city surrounded by public transport, shops, offices, schools, restaurants, hotels and a residential area with a medium-high purchasing power, which makes it one of the best areas to invest due to the variety of types of businesses that can be carried out in said area.

Corner premises of 102 m² divided into two floors and partitioned, 4 offices, kitchen/office, 1 complete bathroom and toilet inside the office, hot/cold air conditioning, security system, emergency exit lights

with a large entrance providing plenty of natural light to the premises. Possibility of requesting a habitability certificate, it is currently rented with a rent of €750+VAT per month with the contract ending in 2 years, which makes it a perfect investment for an investor.

The price includes 2 parking spaces.

For sale for €280,000 Contact us to schedule a visit and find out about more available premises.
